sentences.text: No: at reset, the applicable UCB rule says the bank may, at its option, provide borrowers a choice to switch to a fixed rate, so it is not mandatory.
The same rule also says that, where such a switch option is provided, the applicable charges for switching from floating to fixed rate must be transparently disclosed and approved by the Board.
The bank’s own policy likewise says the bank may, at its option, offer the borrower a choice to switch to a fixed rate at the time of reset.
